local-exec.command:
sshFlags="-o ControlMaster=auto -o ControlPath=/tmp/%C -o ControlPersist=60 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new"
export NIX_SSHOPTS="$sshFlags"
nix --extra-experimental-features "nix-command flakes" copy --derivation --to ssh-ng://sirver ${ data.external.nixos_eval_chilldom.result.drv }
closure=$(ssh $sshFlags sirver nix-store --verbose --realise ${ data.external.nixos_eval_chilldom.result.drv })
nix --extra-experimental-features "nix-command flakes" copy --from ssh-ng://sirver --to ssh-ng://chilldom "$closure"
ssh $sshFlags chilldom sudo nix-env --profile /nix/var/nix/profiles/system --set "$closure"
ssh $sshFlags chilldom sudo systemd-run --collect --no-ask-password --pipe --quiet --same-dir --wait --setenv LOCALE_ARCHIVE --setenv NIXOS_INSTALL_BOOTLOADER= --service-type exec --unit nixos-switch "$closure/bin/switch-to-configuration" switch
